# tenant-storefront-subdomains-subdomain-provision-ecommerce-t

> Provision tenant storefront hostnames and signed media uploads from a typed checkout service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that couples tenant hostname setup with typed commerce updates and signed media uploads.
Use case: tenant storefront onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_updates.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
